results.headline: Trading Update
results.key_quote: Trading in Line with Expectations; Full Year Guidance Maintained
results.summary: Grafton Group reported trading in line with expectations for the four-month period to 31 October 2026. Group average daily like-for-like revenue growth improved to 2.0% from 0.6% in H1, supported by strong momentum in Iberia and continued growth in Island of Ireland, offsetting weak GB market conditions. Full-year guidance for adjusted operating profit of £190m-£200m was maintained, demonstrating confidence in the outlook. Performance was described as resilient despite mixed geographic performance.

results.headline: Agdz Cu-Ag Project Exploration Update - Morocco
results.key_quote: We are making steady and good progress across our Moroccan portfolio, with systematic, disciplined and JV-funded exploration programmes continuing to advance our projects towards drill-ready status.
results.summary: Aterian announced initial results from a 480 m trenching programme at its Agdz copper-silver project in Morocco. The work identified a mineralised fault zone over approximately 350 m at Amzwaro South with selected channel results including 3.10 m at 0.67% copper and 23.16 g/t silver, and 2.00 m at 0.88% copper and 18.00 g/t silver. However, this is an exploration update with no comparison to market expectations, analyst forecasts, or board guidance. The company describes progress as 'steady and good' but makes no statement about beating or meeting expectations.

results.summary: This is an announcement notice that Sunbelt Rentals will report second quarter fiscal year 2027 results on December 8, 2026. No actual results, performance metrics, or guidance information is disclosed in this announcement. The company has not yet reported results or compared performance to any expectations. This is purely a scheduling notice for an upcoming earnings call.

results.headline: Year-end Trading Update
results.key_quote: Wash.ME is expected to deliver a c.14% increase in revenue in FY 2026 compared with FY 2025...achieved despite softer consumer demand for laundry drying services due to a sustained period of abnormally hot and dry summer weather across Europe.
results.summary: Mixed performance: Wash.ME operations exceeded expectations with 14% revenue growth despite challenging summer weather, and secured a major strategic partnership with ASDA. However, Photo.ME revenue declined approximately 4% year-on-year due to regulatory changes in Japan and Germany and softer consumer demand. The board guidance of total revenue not less than £309 million and adjusted profit before tax not less than £66 million appears to be stated as floors with no explicit comparison to prior market expectations. The company emphasizes resilience in Wash.ME against headwinds, suggesting some element of outperformance in that division.
metrics_ahead: Wash.ME revenue growth of 14% achieved despite abnormally hot/dry summer weather (headwind overcome)
Net installation of 1,224 laundry machines representing 16% year-on-year increase
Strategic ASDA partnership with ambition for 700 machines

results.headline: Q3 Trading Update 2026
results.key_quote: Core operating EPS growth remains on track to be above the top-end of our 6-9% target range for 2026
results.summary: Legal & General delivered positive Q3 momentum with multiple metrics ahead of expectations. Core operating EPS growth is tracking above the top-end of the 6-9% target range. Institutional Retirement achieved £6.7bn written or exclusive transactions YTD with IFRS new business margin ahead of H1 levels (4.2%). Asset Management ANNR increased to £25m from £2m in Q3 2026. Retail delivered strong growth across all businesses with Workplace net flows of £8.0bn YTD (57% growth) and Protection APE of £248.4m (21% growth). Solvency ratio increased to 213%, above the 160-190% target operating range. Company remains on track to exceed £400m asset optimisation target and meet or exceed strategic targets set in 2024.
metrics_ahead: Core operating EPS growth above top-end of 6-9% target range
Institutional Retirement IFRS new business margin ahead of H1 4.2%
Asset Management ANNR £25m vs £2m in Q3 2025
Retail Workplace net flows £8.0bn (57% YoY growth)
Solvency II ratio 213% above 160-190% target range

results.headline: Trading Update, Notice of Results & Presentations
results.key_quote: The Board is very pleased to report strong growth in the underlying business in the Period, reflecting growth of circa 25% in non-NATO Support and Procurement Agency revenues, and resulting in revenue and adjusted profit before tax exceeding the exceptionally strong prior year comparative
results.summary: Solid State reports H1 2026/27 revenue and adjusted profit before tax exceeding prior year comparatives despite a difficult comparative period. Revenue expected to exceed £87.5m and adjusted profit before tax to exceed £5.0m, representing performance ahead of the exceptionally strong prior year. Components division revenue circa 30% ahead of prior period with improved margins. Systems division underlying business (excluding NSPA) grew approximately 30%. Power division revenues approximately 10% ahead. The group achieved this growth while investing in own-brand products and capacity expansion.
metrics_ahead: Adjusted profit before tax exceeding prior year comparative
Components division revenue 30% ahead of prior period
Power division revenues 10% ahead of prior period
Improved gross and operating margins across divisions

results.headline: Final Results & Notice of AGM
results.key_quote: The Company is pleased to announce its Final Results for the year ended 30 June 2026
results.summary: Westmount Energy announced final results for the year ended 30 June 2026. The announcement contains operational highlights including the pending cashless acquisition of JHI by Eco (Atlantic) Oil & Gas Ltd with Westmount to hold approximately 9.5M common shares in the enlarged entity, strategic partnerships and farm-in transactions across the portfolio, and cash position of £0.110M with listed marketable securities of £0.772M at year-end. The Chairman's review provides extensive commentary on the macro energy market environment but contains no comparison of results to expectations, guidance, or forecasts. No specific financial metrics, profit figures, or performance comparisons versus expectations are disclosed in the provided excerpt.

results.headline: Drilling Results
results.key_quote: These results are another positive step forward. Today's intercepts compare favourably with those reported before, supporting the upcoming Mineral Resource Estimate.
results.summary: CMR reported drilling results from 15 diamond drillholes at its Agadir Melloul copper-silver project in Morocco. Key intercepts include 2.2m at 2.5% Cu and 77 g/t Ag, and 8.0m at 1.0% Cu and 2 g/t Ag. The company states results compare favourably with previously reported intercepts and support the upcoming mineral resource estimate. However, no explicit comparison to market expectations, analyst forecasts, or board guidance is provided. The announcement focuses on technical drilling data and project development strategy rather than performance versus expectations.

results.key_quote: NAV/share increase of 68% since 1 January 2026...estimated unaudited NAV per share was 3.9p, up 68% since the start of the year and 153% since inception in January 2023, a compounded annualised growth rate of 28%
results.summary: Kelso reports strong NAV per share performance with 68% growth since the start of 2026 and 153% cumulative growth since inception. The company notes portfolio gains of approximately £9.2m and highlights that several holdings have appreciated significantly. The announcement emphasizes strong performance exceeding the company's expectations for portfolio growth, with the CEO/CIO expressing confidence in the underlying valuations. However, this is primarily a portfolio update rather than a detailed business performance announcement with formal guidance comparisons.
metrics_ahead: NAV per share growth of 68% year-to-date
cumulative NAV per share growth of 153% since inception

results.headline: Interim results for six months ended 30 Sept 2026
results.key_quote: Sirius delivered another strong first half with like-for-like rent roll growth of 5.1% and total rent roll growth of 11.3% overall...continue to drive FFO and deliver inflation beating dividend growth for our shareholders.
results.summary: Sirius Real Estate reported strong interim results with multiple metrics significantly exceeding expectations. Revenue increased 17.9% to €191.4m, FFO grew 11.9% to €72.4m with per-share growth of 6.5%, like-for-like rent roll grew 5.1%, and total rent roll increased 11.3%. Profit before tax (excluding revaluations) surged 39.2% to €60.0m. EPRA earnings per share increased 29.2% and headline earnings per share increased 31.7%. The company achieved its 26th consecutive dividend increase and management commentary emphasizes strong operational performance, organic growth, successful acquisitions, and confidence in future growth prospects despite macroeconomic uncertainty.

results.headline: Final Results for the year to 30 June 2026
results.key_quote: The year saw encouraging progress at Aracari, where reconnaissance, mapping, sampling and ground magnetometry strengthened our confidence in the project's gold potential and helped define targets for further exploration.
results.summary: BWA Group reported final results for the year to 30 June 2026 with no explicit comparison to market, analyst or board expectations. The announcement focuses on operational progress at exploration projects in Cameroon and Canada, including encouraging fieldwork results at the Aracari Gold Project and a post-year-end resource upgrade at a partner project. No profit figures, revenue metrics or guidance changes are disclosed in the announcement excerpt provided, and no reference is made to beating or missing expectations. The tone is positive regarding project development but without quantitative performance comparisons to expectations.

results.headline: Preliminary Results
results.key_quote: Strong growth and accelerating performance throughout the year delivered revenue and Adjusted EBITDA in line with upgraded market expectations
results.summary: Applied Nutrition delivered FY26 results with revenue up 50.9% to £161.6m and Adjusted EBITDA up 40.1% to £43.3m, stated as in line with upgraded management guidance provided in August 2026. The company has entered FY27 with very strong momentum and continued market share gains. While results are described as 'in line' with upgraded expectations rather than beating them, the upgrade itself and the strong operational performance (revenue growth of 50.9%, margin expansion, successful acquisitions and facility expansion) indicate performance ahead of prior market expectations. The CEO commentary emphasizes accelerating performance and entering FY27 with 'very strong momentum.'
metrics_ahead: Strong momentum continuing into Q1 FY27
Market share gains across key channels
Net cash position maintained at £15.9m despite investments

results.headline: Laguna Verde CEOL Update
results.key_quote: Although we had anticipated completion of the CEOL Decree ratification process within the government's previously indicated timetable, we are encouraged by the continued engagement and efforts of the Chilean authorities to progress the approval
results.summary: CleanTech Lithium provided an update on the Laguna Verde CEOL (Special Lithium Operating Contract) approval process. The Comptroller returned the CEOL Decree to the Ministry of Economy and Mining with observations on 13 November 2026, but the decree has not been rejected. The Ministry is actively working to address these observations. The company states it had anticipated completion within a previously indicated timetable but expresses encouragement about continued government engagement. No financial results, operational metrics, or performance comparisons to expectations were disclosed in this announcement.

results.headline: P2634 interest to double and Finn resource update
results.key_quote: Orcadian is pleased to announce that its interest in the P2634 (Finn) licence is expected to double from 50% to 100% on the withdrawal of Serica Energy Norte Ltd...Orcadian has recently completed...a detailed reservoir engineering evaluation of alternative development schemes which could work on Finn.
results.summary: Orcadian Energy announced an increase in its P2634 licence interest from 50% to 100% following Serica's withdrawal, along with updated resource estimates. The company completed Phase A work including detailed reservoir engineering evaluation identifying a warm polymer flood development strategy with 42.1% recovery factor. Revised P50 oil-in-place for Finn is 1,029 MMbbl with 325 MMbbl 2C contingent resources on licence (26% uplift from previous 257 MMbbl estimate). Total resources on P2634 now 348 MMbbl. However, no financial guidance, profit expectations, or performance metrics versus market/analyst expectations are provided. The announcement is entirely focused on asset/resource position rather than operational or financial performance versus expectations.
